description: This file defines the DestroyPurgeStrategy class, which extends PurgeStrategy and implements a method to purge employee records based on an employee number within the OrangeHRM system's maintenance plugin.

classes.name: DestroyPurgeStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class for purging employee-related entities based on employee number within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Removes entity records related to the given employee number.
